label: D1 after a reward while the agent leans to a1
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (99.7% of mass) when the reward input is 1 (previous trial rewarded) and the agent is set to choose a1: 99.8% of mass has the upcoming action a1, 78% has previous action a1, and its policy logit(a1)-logit(a2) is moderately positive (2.8 to 8). It never fires at GO, almost never at D2 (0.3%), and never after a2 choices or unrewarded trials. Recorded the observed-only version, using the policy logit in place of the future action; (phase==D1)&(prev_reward==1)&(action==1) has mass recall 0.996 but precision 0.28. Precision stays low (about 0.39) because many D1 steps that match look the same as the ones that fire. Rate also falls with episode time: highest in trials 10-60, near zero after trial 80. Adding ep_trial<75 raises F1 to 0.63, so the unit likely tracks a slowly drifting part of the hidden state as well as a1-rewarded. Magnitude is highest when there have been several a1 rewards in a row (top windows) and weakest on isolated rewards. Rough reading: a rewarded-a1 / stay-on-a1 signal at D1.
